profile.subtitle: Hi, I'm
profile.bio: Fourth-year Software Engineering student with internship experience building full-stack and back-end solutions using TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and AWS. Skilled in designing scalable systems, automating workflows, and integrating AI-driven capabilities including vector embeddings and CI/CD pipelines.
profile.education: B.Sc. in Software Engineering | Minor in Legal Studies | Rochester Institute of Technology | May 2028
profile.experienceYears: Internship Experience | Full Stack & Backend | AI/Cloud

bullets: Built a Docker-based document migration microservice using Node.js, AWS, and MongoDB, improving business observability and large-scale data ingestion.
Automated JSON schema generation with TypeScript, Angular, and CI/CD pipelines by mapping collection attributes via metadata parsing, reducing generation time from 5 minutes to 1 second.
Engineered MongoDB databases to store migration metadata and implemented vector embeddings for vector search, reducing business inquiry response time by 5–7 days.
Integrated AI-enabled analytics using the MongoDB Model Context Protocol (MCP) to support natural-language queries and data analysis.
Implemented AWS SQS for asynchronous vector embedding and data transfer, ensuring high-throughput migration performance.
Created Datadog dashboards and integrated AWS SNS alarms to monitor critical application errors 10% faster.
Delivered biweekly production releases in an Agile team using CI/CD pipelines and Git best practices.
Driving 500+ AWS Builder Center signups through peer outreach, events, and campus initiatives.
Creating 24+ pieces of technical and promotional content using AI/LLMs to increase AWS awareness.
Facilitated hands-on AWS demos and ML workshops introducing students to EC2, S3, and Lambda.
Hosted 4 campus tabling events and delivered 10+ classroom announcements to promote AWS programs.
